ازدرعوا (form VIII)
# اِزْدَرَعُوا (izdaraʕū) /iz.da.ra.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِزْدَرَعَ (izdaraʕa)
# اُزْدُرِعُوا (uzduriʕū) /uz.du.ri.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِزْدَرَعَ (izdaraʕa)
# اِزْدَرِعُوا (izdariʕū) /iz.da.ri.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِزْدَرَعَ (izdaraʕa)
